newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Pacific Coast Apparel rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Pacific Coast Apparel rated buy.

text.p: -- National Securities Corp said it initiated coverage of Pacific Coast Apparel Co with a buy rating.
-- In a report dated November 1, National Securities said Pacific Coast shares are down more than 50 percent since its initial public offering in August. National Securities underwrote that offering.
-- Pacific Coast shares closed on Monday at 1-1/2.
-- "(Pacific Coast) is very cheap, especially when one considers the upside potential of a brand designer," National Securities said.
